title: Rework Courtesy Rental Days: Workmanship Warranties Rental Entitlement Note
content:
**Entitlement.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, when the plan's rework target business days exceed its courtesy rental minimum rework days, the network pays a courtesy rental on a covered network rework for the number of rework courtesy rental days; otherwise it pays none. The rework courtesy rental days are the plan's courtesy rental days, counted one rental day for each, a whole number of days.

## The two questions the note answers

| Question | Rule |
|---|---|
| Does the network pay a courtesy rental on the rework? | Only when the plan's rework target business days are greater than the plan's courtesy rental minimum rework days; when they are equal or fewer, it pays none. |
| For how many days? | The plan's courtesy rental days, one rental day for each, as a whole number of days. |


## Worked figures (hypothetical plan figures)

| Rework target business days | Courtesy rental minimum rework days | Plan's courtesy rental days | Rework courtesy rental days |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | 2 | 4 | 4 |
| 2 | 2 | 4 | 0, the target not exceeding the minimum |
| 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
